identificationModule.briefTitle: Clinical Study on Savolitinib + Osimertinib in Treatment of EGFRm+/MET+ Locally Advanced or Metastatic NSCLC
identificationModule.officialTitle: A Multicenter, Randomized, Double-blind, Phase III Clinical Study to Evaluate the Efficacy and Safety of Savolitinib + Osimertinib Versus Placebo + Osimertinib as the First Line Therapy for Patients With EGFRm+/MET+ NSCLC

descriptionModule.briefSummary: A Phase III Clinical Study on Savolitinib Combined with Osimertinib in Treatment of EGFRm+/MET+ Locally Advanced or Metastatic Non-small Cell Lung Cancer
descriptionModule.detailedDescription: A Multicenter, Randomized, Double-blind, Phase III Clinical Study to Evaluate the Efficacy and Safety of Savolitinib Combined with Osimertinib versus Placebo Combined with Osimertinib as the First-line Therapy for Patients with EGFRm+/MET+ Locally Advanced or Metastatic Non-small Cell Lung Cancer

designInfo.interventionModelDescription:
This study plans to enroll 412 patients, among them, there are 92 subjects in Savolitinib/Placebo QD administration; and about 320 subjects in Savolitinib/Placebo BID administration will be randomized in a ratio of 1 to 1 into the study group and the control group.

Study group: Savolitinib 600 mg or 400 mg daily (including 600/400 mg QD or 300/200 mg BID) orally + Osimertinib 80 mg QD orally Control group: Placebo 600 mg or 400 mg daily (including 600/400 mg QD or 300/200 mg BID) orally+ Osimertinib 80 mg QD orally

armGroups.label: Savolitinib
armGroups.description: Savolitinib 600 mg or 400 mg daily (including 600/400 mg QD or 300/200 mg BID) orally

armGroups.label: placebo
armGroups.description: Placebo 600 mg or 400 mg daily (including 600/400 mg QD or 300/200 mg BID) orally

interventions.name: Savolitinib
interventions.description: Subjects will receive Savolitinib 600 mg or 400 mg daily (including 600/400 mg QD or 300/200 mg BID) orally, 21day cycles (every 3 weeks) until disease progression, death, adverse event (AE) leading to discontinuation or withdrawal of consent.

interventions.name: Placebo
interventions.description: Subjects will receive Placebo 600 mg or 400 mg daily (including 600/400 mg QD or 300/200 mg BID) orally, 21day cycles (every 3 weeks) until disease progression, death, adverse event (AE) leading to discontinuation or withdrawal of consent.
